messages.text: Check if there are new comments on the PR and address them if present
I’ll check PR #90 for new comments and address any follow-ups on its current branch.

There is a new comment asking for the same approach on the inner barrel: move the chambers on coil planes below the coils and widen the chambers between coils.

I’ll check the available space first. The inner BT legs sit close to the HCAL, so the requested placement may need a change to another component. I’ll use the repository’s design-evidence workflow to document what fits.

The first calculation shows a space conflict. Below the BT warm inner face, a 500 mm chamber needs its centre radius at or below 4.05 m. The actual HCAL flat face—not just its corner envelope—requires at least 4.458 m with the same clearances.

I’m checking that against the finite HCAL solids and testing an outward stagger of the inter-coil chambers as a separate option. The plotting environment also has changed Spack fingerprints; I’ll re-verify it before use.

The finite-solid checks confirm that all 48 coil-plane chambers would intersect HCAL steel or the rear cover at the proposed lower radius.

The outward inter-coil trial clears the hardware, but adds 48 chambers and reduces the sampled three-station geometric coverage by about one percentage point after frame cuts and finite ends are included. I’ll document both results and leave the current layout in place pending a choice about the HCAL–coil gap or chamber depth.

The new drawings show the HCAL collision directly and separate it from the outward trial. Both options remain studies; the published chamber OBJ and joint field are unchanged. A separate validation agent is checking the frozen results before I post the reviewer response.

The independent reviewer also confirms that the HCAL obstruction is real. The new report quantifies the missing radial space and the outward trial’s coverage loss. I’m finishing the response around the design choice needed before the proposed inward layout can proceed.

The independent assessment is complete. It reproduces the HCAL collision, the outward trial’s coverage loss, and the source geometry shown in the figures. It also confirms that the active geometry, OBJ and field files are unchanged. I’ll now post the result and the physical choices needed to continue.

The [reviewer response is posted](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/90#issuecomment-6290165866). It explains the HCAL conflict and why the tested outward alternative was not adopted. The current layout and field remain unchanged; I’m closing the validated project records now.

Found one new inner-barrel comment and [replied with checked figures and results](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/90#issuecomment-6290165866).

The requested below-coil placement conflicts with HCAL at the retained 500 mm chamber depth. The tested outward alternative clears the hardware but worsens three-station geometric coverage.

The current **888-chamber layout and field remain unchanged**, pending a gap/depth design choice. Independent checks passed; GitHub’s build is pending.
